result.note: Tests the procurement category, joint-venture partner and local-content floor of the October 2026 BrahMos launcher contract.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, the Ministry of Defence signed a contract with BrahMos Aerospace for missile fire control systems and launchers on Indian Navy warships. Consider the following statements about the order:
items: It was placed under the Buy (Global) procurement category.
The contractor, BrahMos Aerospace, is an India-Russia joint venture.
The order carries at least 68 per cent local content.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the order falls under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category, used for equipment designed, developed and manufactured in India. The INR 6.62 billion contract covers the BrahMos, a supersonic missile that is the Navy's primary ship-to-ship strike weapon.
questions.source: The order falls under the Buy (Indian-IDDM) category, used for equipment designed, developed, and manufactured in India, and carries at least 68 per cent local content.
